newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia is likely to spend more than 23 billion riyals on the education sector until the year 2000.
- Expert tells Saudi firms to provide quality on Internet.
- Saudi industry minister says Gulf Cooperation Council industries should meet local requirements.
- Saudi Arabia beheads a national for rape and theft.
- A new 300 million riyal cement company to be set up.
- Tourism investment opportunities in Saudi Arabia's eastern province worth five billion riyals, Saudi official says.
- Health ministry identifies 215 of the 343 pilgrims killed in a fire near Mecca last month.
